metadata.description: Simplified Future Land Use Map for the Manhattan Planning Jurisdictional Area. Based on goals and policies in the Manhattan Growth Policy adopted May 2024.
metadata.note: This is a planning-level generalization. For detailed zoning within town limits, refer to the Manhattan Town Zoning Districts layer.

properties.description: Incorporated area of Manhattan with established zoning districts. See Town Zoning Districts layer for detailed zone boundaries (CBD, LI, NHB, POS, LDR, MDR, RT).
properties.primary_uses: Residential, commercial, industrial, parks per town zoning ordinance

properties.description: Areas within approximately 0.5 miles of town limits suitable for future residential development at urban densities. Per Growth Policy, new residential development should be concentrated adjacent to town limits.
properties.primary_uses: Single-family residential, two-family residential, neighborhood services

properties.description: Conservation easements, public lands, and protected open space within the Planning Jurisdictional Area. Includes drainageways, floodplains, and areas under conservation management.
properties.primary_uses: Open space, conservation, passive recreation, wildlife habitat, agriculture under easement

properties.description: 100-year floodplain and floodway within the Planning Jurisdictional Area. Development discouraged per Growth Policy. Includes FEMA-designated Special Flood Hazard Areas.
properties.primary_uses: Floodplain management, open space, agriculture, riparian conservation

properties.description: Agricultural lands comprising the majority of the Planning Jurisdictional Area outside town limits. Per Growth Policy: 'All possible efforts should be made to preserve agriculture.' Development at densities greater than 1 unit per half acre is discouraged.
properties.primary_uses: Agriculture, ranching, farming, rural residential at very low density
